name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd. (Domino's India, Popeyes, Dunkin')
business_summary: Master franchisee of Domino's Pizza in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh and Turkey (Turkey ~5% of revenue, model knowledge) plus Popeyes, Hong's Kitchen and Dunkin'. TTM sales Rs 9,838 cr, EBITDA margin ~20% (post-IndAS), PAT Rs 450 cr, P/E 78. 3,820 stores at Q2 FY27 (Oct 2026 update). Domino's India LFL +4% versus store growth; stock -24% in 12 months, near 52-week low.

exposures.mechanism: Domino's India LFL is only +4% on 12% revenue growth; +5pp urban demand -> LFL +2.5pp -> revenue +2.5%; ~45% decremental margin on a 20% (IndAS) EBITDA margin -> EBITDA +5.6%; EV/MCap 1.15, persistence 0.5-0.6 -> ~+3.7.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +11.9% to Rs2,608.7 cr; Domino's India LFL +4%; stores 3,820; shares -4 to -6% (Reuters/CNBC TV18/ET)
Q1 FY27 sales 2,570 cr, OP 504 cr (20%), PAT 100 cr; mcap 29,848 cr, P/E 78
